text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've all come to cheer for Silence
Suzuka in her
exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whew, made it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, you must be...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's the name! Has Suzuka
already
run?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And here's another star descending onto
the turf,
Silence Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hello...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka! SUZUKAAA!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, hehe... Spe's here too.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Suzuka!
Suzukaaa! You can
do it!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see... This is them sending me off—until
I come
back safe to them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The gates fly open, and her race begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dominates in a gate-to-wire romp.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, all of you, for your support
today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
With you cheering me on, I was able to
take first.
And now, I'd like to sing my
thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! Welcome hooome!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
You were great, Suzuka!
Welcome home!
Amazing running today!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... So, they've been saying it this
whole time,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And look how much their expressions
have
changed since before the race.
They all look so
happy...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What's... gotten into me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, I want to return to this
place
again. Here, where they're all
waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I still want to run and run as far as my legs will take me, but I also want to... I need to come back here.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I, um... have something to tell you all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
This won't be the last time I come home
to you.
So please...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to my next concert. I hope
it'll be
fun for all of us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaaa! We'll be waiting for youuu...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, as we're working on
the Grand
Concert...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Are you the ones doing that
Grand
Concert project Suzuka's a part
of?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, that's us!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, please let me join! Pretty
please!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
We get to stand on the same stage as
Suzuka?
And sing G1 songs too?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Is it true that anyone can get up on stage and sing their gratitude? I've never gotten to hold a mic even once!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's true!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll all tell our fans how grateful we
are for them
together! That's what the
Grand Concert's all
about!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, everyone wants to get in on it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And who do you think is in large part
responsible
for that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I must say you gave us quite
the
spectacular reaction at that concert.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which means there must have been
some change
in you that sparked it. Or
rather, you found
something... didn't
you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Mhm... I thought about what concerts
mean to
me... to everyone, and—

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: ENOUGH!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-is something the matter? There's no
need to
yell...

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
This whole Grand Concert thing needs
to end
now!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
...So those are the people going on
about this
"Grand Concert"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember her watching one of our
concerts,
with anger radiating from her
face.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Everyone gets to sing? Cut the crap!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do you mean? This will be an

opportunity for all of you to give thanks
to your
fans!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: We don't need that! The fact that you have to win is what makes concerts special!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
We all want to sing, to stand center
stage! Our
fans cheer for us because
they want to see us
there too!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
What's the point if everyone gets to
sing? Don't
cheapen our hard work!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
You say it's for the fans, but to me it just
sounds
like an excuse to escape from the
reality that we
can't win!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Th-that's not...

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Runners like you could never understand
how us
losers feel! Just leave us alone!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Er, I think I'm gonna head out...

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, me too. I have training to do.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: W-wait! What about wanting to join us?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but uh... I don't think I'm ready for
the
stage yet.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Your songs... your words
matter
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A stifling silence descends, and we
decide to call
it for the day.
